errors.text_span: The donut chart represents the distribution of task types, comparing the proportions of different categories. The chart is divided into three sectors. The largest sector is labeled "Article generation" and is colored red, occupying approximately 82.9% of the chart. The second-largest sector is labeled "Article editing" and is colored blue, accounting for around 14.6%. The smallest sector is labeled "Headline generation" and is colored yellow, making up about 2.4%. The chart includes labels with percentages for each sector outside the donut chart, and the title "Task Type" is displayed in the center of the chart. The sectors appear to be arranged in descending order of size.
